backend: native CPU, ordinary waking plasticity active
method: PyTorch reconstruction of native cadence-aware microsteps, followed by additive genetic-weight edits and native physical selection. This is feedback-driven hill climbing, not replication of the paper one-shot restrictions.

phase_fit.method: Scalar native leak/Tanh/metabolic equations over frozen two-phase source traces; b solves painless final activation0.02. Other weak inputs and future plasticity/body feedback are omitted, so native physical tests remain necessary.

prior_screen_plan.goal: Reduce the existing positive Inspect prior across object properties while preserving ordinary meals. Prior0 is an ablation control, not automatic preferred policy. Compare against Contact20 and the previously frozen pain candidate; no shared-parent promotion.

release_pilot_plan.goal: Phase-aware pain motor recruits existing release then suppresses reacquisition. Experimental child of Contact20 with prior0.125; no World/runtime change or parent promotion.

long_plan.goal: Reject short-horizon survival if it merely delays death. g8r8 retained pilot food; g16r24 is an explicit lower-injury/missed-food tradeoff control. No parent promotion.

heldout_plan.selection: g16r24 kept all 11 ordinary pilot meals and survived/eat all three long hazard/mixed cases. It missed the single short pilot mixed meal, which remains a declared limitation. Freeze all weights before fresh held-out controls. Contact20 remains common parent.

export.name: pursuit-twohead-contact20-release16x24
export.validation_note: First comparison incorrectly included trace-only target_motion; original AssertionError retained. Comparison corrected without rerunning that life. All physical metrics exact.

limits: All food targets are ordinary Food objects, including moving targets; no living-prey kill or consumption capability is claimed.
The release candidate largely stops handling the hazard after the first256 intervals but remains within reach; this is reduced harmful handling, not learned escape.
Ordinary meal total intervals rise from5810 to6112 on the identical98 successful cases (5.20%).
Mixed hazard/food successes are2/10 versus1/10 baseline, but the baseline successful seed is lost; there is no universal dominance.
Final injury uses each life terminal endpoint; meals end a trial early, so it is not equal-duration cumulative injury.
No hosted CI, GPU behavior, acquired checkpoint migration, general intelligence or statistical significance claim.
Two local replay boundaries establish forward parity only; neither broad gradient equivalence nor whole training parity is implied.
